{{Short description|German mathematician}}
[[Image:Herberstein, Ferdinand Ernst Karl - Cyclo-diatomia, 1716 - BEIC 1470714.jpg|thumb|''Cyclo-diatomia'', 1716]]

'''Ferdinand Ernst Karl''' [[count]] of Herberstein (died 1720) was a German [[mathematician]] and a [[Officer (armed forces)|military officer]].<ref>{{cite web|url= http://thesaurus.cerl.org/record/cnp00110142|title= Herberstein, Ferd8inand Ernst von ( –1720) in Cerl Thesaurus}}</ref>

== Life ==

Son of Karl Sigmund, he lived in [[Bohemia]]. He wrote several books about [[mathematics]] and [[geometry]]. Some of the books are signed using the pseudonym of "Amari de Lapide".<ref>{{cite web|url= https://de.wikisource.org/wiki/BLK%C3%96:Herberstein,_Ferdinand_Ernst_Karl_Graf_von/|title= BLKÖ:Herberstein, Ferdinand Ernst Karl Graf von}}</ref>

== Works ==
* ''Norma et regula statica intersectione circulorum desumta'', Praga 1686
* ''Mathemata adversu umbratiles Petri Poireti impetus propugnata'', Praga, 1709
* ''Diatome circulorum seu specimen geometricum'', Praga, 1710
* ''Erotema politico-philologicum an studium Geometriae rempublicam administranti obstaculo sit an adminiculo?'', Praga, 1712
* {{Cite book|publisher= typis universitatis Carolo-Ferdinandeae in Collegio sJesu ad sClementem
